items.text: changed: the hand button no longer has a hidden pop-out menu, because hand, hold and pencil are all on the rail already.
changed: in edit mode the pencil and its five tools (column, row, copy, cut, paste) are one block, and the yellow edge runs down all of it instead of capping the pencil and leaving a gap.
changed: touching the pencil now morphs the rail: the icons that go slide down and fade, the new ones slide up into place, and it runs in reverse when you go back to the hand.

changed: every pane of the heads-up display now has a clear title across the top, with its icon and its place in the strip (for example "Mixer, 1 / 8"), the way Current names its panels, so you always know where you are.
changed: tapping Colour or Shape while Halo is on now turns Halo off and picks that one in the same tap, so there is no need to switch Halo off first.

changed: Stay awake is now a button in the bottom bar, next to Full screen, instead of a symbol floating top right that could sit on top of the hand button. It is lit while the screen is being kept awake.

changed: on a tablet or desktop the heads-up display is now a normal-size panel docked above the tempo bar, with the stage still in view and playable above it, and the pin keeps it up. On a phone it still fills the stage. The bottom bar takes a reasonable width, centred, on one line.

changed: Halo now sits alone on the right rail as a mode you switch on and use. Colour and Shape sit in their own group below it, because they are what you draw with, and they only work with Halo off: with Halo on they are dimmed and ignore taps.

changed: Halo and the two strips under the stage (colours, shapes) are now one choice on the right rail, not both at once. With Halo on, the strips are hidden and the room goes back to the stage. In the Halo, every mark is drawn in the colour you are drawing with, and a colour chip under the frame opens the colours (pick one and it returns to the marks). The top label now names the kind of mark. The Colour and Shape buttons switch to painting with the strips.

changed: while you edit, the Halo, Colour and Shape switches moved to the right rail under the clipboard buttons (icons only). The colours and the shapes are now two rows of round buttons in the same eight columns, so each colour sits directly over a shape. That frees the row they used under the stage.
